svg.title: EP2 C3 AREA 18
svg.desc: In CCA, fight gatekeepers only. Complete every marked fixed pickup and split-route mechanism. Both groups go straight to the exit room, defeat the Gibbles and move on; the rest of the area can be skipped. Both starts are right next to the exit room; each pair walks straight in and regroups. Defeat the Gibbles to make the warp appear, then continue to the next area.
